message:
test(maint r1 #2): the legacy-adjacent fixture picks its port pair at random, not after the OS's TCP cursor

StartLegacyAdjacent took the OS's bind(0) TCP port P and wanted UDP P+1, 32 times. On this machine
bind(0) hands TCP ports out one after another (40 binds: 51809..51848), and UDP has reserved ranges of
its own (netsh excludedportrange udp: 60182-60381, 62131-62230, 50000-50059). With the TCP cursor just
below such a range every attempt failed together -- the run2 "adjacent udp port was not free after 32
tries" of 10-28. Reproduced with the same rule from PowerShell: cursor moved to 60170, then P=60171..60180
paired and every P from 60181 failed (22/32); a random base found a pair at once.

Now a random base in [49152, 65533] for TCP B and UDP B+1, up to 256 independent tries. What the fixture
provides and how a failure shows (the caller's loud FAIL) are unchanged.

Product: none. Test: directory_fake_server.hpp, retry test message. Docs: report_maint_r1.
